caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic teapot with a lid. The teapot is primarily a light beige or ivory color with decorative patterns in brown and green. The body of the teapot is adorned with a detailed floral and leafy motif in reddish-brown, with some flowers and leaves highlighted in pale green and yellow. Both the spout and the handle are designed to resemble bamboo, displaying naturalistic segments and shading in tones of brown, green, and beige. The lid, which is tilted and partially inserted into the opening, repeats the same floral and leafy patterns, and features a handle that also mimics a knot of bamboo with green and brown coloring. The rim of the teapot has a thin decorative border. The overall composition is centered on a neutral, light beige background, and the objects occupy most of the image space.
title: Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
